1.body:
Hi,

I am applying for the Product Designer internship at FarmDidi because your mission to simplify operations for rural women entrepreneurs aligns with my interest in building accessible, high-impact tools.

During my time at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated complex user feedback into refined interface flows. I am comfortable working directly with developers to ensure that design mockups translate accurately into functional products, a skill I developed while bridging the gap between design and technical implementation.

You can see my approach in my Bounceless case study, which demonstrates how I structured a complex B2B verification flow into a clean, intuitive interface: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and am ready to relocate to Pune for this role. Would you be open to a brief call next week to discuss how I can support your design team?

Ananya
